items.text: Career counselling after 12th takes that exact shortlist and works it down to one clear recommendation, built on your real strengths, work style, and a skill direction aimed at earlier financial freedom, instead of leaving you to keep re-arguing the same comparison.
Counselling is delivered fully online across India, students and families can start from home, college, or wherever they already are, no travel, no waiting for a local option.
